source.title: Answering Earth's Call
source.description:
Life grow now. Need more. Need stop corruption.

<Rocks scrape against each other as the elemental shifts.>

Feralas. Elements. Essence and Shrine.

Find. Use Fragment and find. Help life grow.
source.objective:
Collect 3 Elemental Essence from the water elementals on The Forgotten Coast across from Sardor Isle in Feralas and combine them with the Fragment of Earth to summon help at the corrupted shrine there.

Provided item:
source.completion: Life grow here now. Need more. Other elements. Help.
